summary: Dataset and method pages now report missing or invalid origin labels instead of substituting a hard-coded start year.
details: Dataset loads validate current project headers against Project Settings and the CSV row count, without reusing stale sidecar labels.
Dataset Viewer, DFM, Result Selection, and Bornhuetter Ferguson show an actionable Origin Start Date error when labels cannot be resolved.
Manual dataset creation rejects missing or invalid Project Settings date boundaries instead of creating a default-sized dataset.
